messages.author: 17a55e730e8f60ef
messages.subject: Remove X-axis annotation
parts:
I would like to remove the x-axis ticks on a plot. I know how to
change the axis labels and annotations with xlab() or scale_x_discrete
(), but I haven't figured out the command to remove the ticks. Is
there a way to remove the axis tick marks for one axis?

Thanks,
rich

messages.author: 539623a2f30c9e53
messages.subject: Re: Remove X-axis annotation
parts:
Use breaks=NA:

scale_x_continuous(breaks=NA)

It also removes the guidelines on the background of the plot.

Jonathan
